note: Data of graph.fix (`dead-code-checker graph fix --dry-run`). codes: the dead-symbol findings whose symbols the patch may remove, and only when a corroboration stands behind them (graph.verdict: a dc.suspect is never removed). span_langs: the languages whose extractor gives the exact span of a definition AND that graph.fix can check against the source before it cuts (python: the span of the ast node, decorators included); a symbol of any other language is listed as manual, never patched. kinds: the symbol kinds that are removed. verify (graph.fixverify, `graph fix --dry-run --verify`): local = NON-EXECUTING checks that may run on this machine (the toolchain ones only in the bubblewrap box and only for a command that graph.fixverify.NON_EXECUTING names: this file cannot add one); runtime = EXECUTING checks (tests, build scripts, maven and gradle plugins, npm scripts), only on a separate execution target (a configured remote host), never here. rounds and checks bound the search per class (a round is one parallel batch); timeout_s is per check; parallel = the runtime checks in flight at once. Per language: local and runtime, `baseline` = run it on the tree as it is first (a check that fails there judges nothing), `marker` = the manifest of the package it runs in, `offline` = the cache family of graph.gocache.

local.class: non-executing: compile(), symtable and ast of the patched files and an import scan of the tree, never run; in the bwrap box when this host has one

runtime.class: executing: the tests of the project

local.class: non-executing: compiles the packages and their tests, runs nothing; offline, in the bwrap box

runtime.class: executing: the tests of the project

local.class: non-executing: type-checks, emits and runs nothing; in the bwrap box

executing: npm scripts and the tests of the project
executing: build.rs and proc-macros run during the check
executing: maven plugins run during the build
